<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1376
Claimant:
Brandon Knight
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
June 20, 2024
Reported today that a sideswipe occurred while the insured was changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant is
represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
July 12, 2024
Confirmed the insured is listed as a named driver on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the
reported loss.
July 13, 2024
Obtained the police report. It records the collision, identifies the claimant as present in the vehicle, and notes two
witnesses who stopped at the scene.
July 23, 2024
Spoke with the other driver, who described the lane change and the contact between the two vehicles in terms that
match the insured's account of the event.
August 8, 2024
Reviewed the scene photographs. The damage to the insured's vehicle lines up with the side impact described by the
parties and the witnesses.
September 3, 2024
Interviewed the first witness, who confirmed seeing the sideswipe and the vehicles separating afterward. The witness
also confirmed that the claimant was seated in the passenger area.
September 18, 2024
Received the claimant's injury description through counsel, whcih reports a back strain. The kind and force of the
impact appear consistent with that injury.
October 7, 2024
Received the initial treatment records. The care began promptly after the accident and followed a typical course for
this type of soft tissue injury.
November 22, 2024
During a second recorded conversation, the claimant described the direction of the impact differently than in the first
call. The claimant also gave a different count of the occupants in the car.
November 28, 2024
A neighbor contacted the desk and stated that the vehicle appeared to already be damaged some weeks before the
reported loss. No photographs or other records have been provided to support this.
December 24, 2024
Checked prior claims and loss databases. No earlier injruy to the same area of the body and no earlier damage to the
insured vehicle appear in the records.
January 28, 2025
Treatment has tapered as the claimant's symptoms improved, and the file is being held pending counsel's response
to the discrepancies in the claimant's recorded statements and the neighbor's information.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
